answer: Reaching the ripple of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the kernel of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lotus re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
